scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cartograph/server && npm run build -w @cartograph/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev -w @cartograph/server & npm run dev -w @cartograph/client)
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @cartograph/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @cartograph/server && npm run typecheck -w @cartograph/client
